head.name: @fzlt/core/perf
head.lead: A live performance overlay for players, off until they switch it on. Frames per second, a rolling frame-time bar chart (one bar per frame, coloured against the budget), dropped frames, the engine's work per frame (read, steps, render), live pooled entities and, where the browser exposes it, the JS heap. It reads the engine's own frames on the shared clock (engine.timing, engine.live): no clock or requestAnimationFrame of its own, and it never calls engine.busy(), so a settling engine still settles and the chart rests with it. Its own cost stays out of what it measures: frame times go into a typed-array ring (nothing is allocated per frame), the numbers are written twice a second through the ledger (change-only, strings cached), the chart is one canvas, and the root is contain: layout paint style and pointer-events: none. Hidden, it only records (a few typed-array writes a frame). Not the dev-only @fzlt/core/debug, which patches Element prototypes: this one ships to players.
